batch.selection: Meta AI 397 份待审母集按冻结顺序排列的第 2 批 60 份资料
batch.admissionRule: 总分至少 6/10，且知识重要性至少 2/3；Cookbook 默认进入补充层

results.title: Cancel a response
results.description: API reference for cancelling an in-progress model response with POST /v1/responses/{response_id}/cancel.

scores.rationale: 取消单一响应是窄操作，状态语义已由 Responses 主指南覆盖。

results.title: Count input tokens
results.description: API reference for counting input tokens with POST /v1/responses/input_tokens.

scores.rationale: 计数端点的调用细节已由 Token counting 主指南覆盖。

results.title: Create a response
results.description: API reference for creating a model response with POST /v1/responses.

scores.rationale: 单一 create response 端点已由 Responses 指南和完整 schema 覆盖。

results.title: Delete a response
results.description: API reference for deleting a model response with DELETE /v1/responses/{response_id}.

scores.rationale: 删除响应是单一 CRUD 操作，不形成独立 AI 知识。

results.title: Retrieve a response
results.description: API reference for retrieving a model response with GET /v1/responses/{response_id}.

scores.rationale: 读取响应是单一 CRUD 操作，可由 Responses 状态管理说明覆盖。

results.title: Responses schemas
results.description: Full schema and model definitions referenced by the Responses API endpoints.

scores.rationale: 完整 Responses schema 精确定义推理、工具、输出项和状态，是实现兼容代理协议的核心契约。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Streaming responses》，本资料的独立增量是：完整 Responses schema 精确定义推理、工具、输出项和状态，是实现兼容代理协议的核心契约。

results.title: Status
results.description: API reference for the unauthenticated /v1/status service-health endpoint.

scores.rationale: 服务健康检查只是运维探针，缺少独立 AI 知识。

results.title: Voice
results.description: API reference for the audio transcription endpoints.

scores.rationale: Voice API 首页只是转录端点目录。

results.title: Transcribe in realtime
results.description: API reference for streaming transcription over a WebSocket at wss://api.meta.ai/v1/asr/realtime.

scores.rationale: 实时 WebSocket 转录的会话事件、音频流和增量结果构成独立协议。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Voice schemas》、《Speech to text》，本资料的独立增量是：实时 WebSocket 转录的会话事件、音频流和增量结果构成独立协议。

results.title: Voice schemas
results.description: Full schema and model definitions referenced by the Audio API endpoints.

scores.rationale: Voice schema 精确定义流式事件、说话人和转录结果，是语音集成的官方契约。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Transcribe in realtime》、《Speech to text》，本资料的独立增量是：Voice schema 精确定义流式事件、说话人和转录结果，是语音集成的官方契约。

results.title: Transcribe a recording
results.description: API reference for transcribing an audio file with POST /v1/asr/transcribe.

scores.rationale: 单文件转录端点已由 Speech to text 主指南和 Voice schema 覆盖。

results.title: Agent patterns
results.description: Cookbook recipes for turning Muse Spark into an agent — the core loop, interleaved reasoning and tool use, context management, and validated edits.

scores.rationale: Agent patterns 是 Cookbook 分类导航，没有独立机制内容。

results.title: Alert fatigue copilot
results.description: Extract grounded patterns from a noisy alert feed with Muse Spark, then probe, chat, and self-assess with strict-JSON output.

scores.rationale: 告警疲劳用例较窄，主要复用结构化输出和接地分析机制。

results.title: Keep an image series consistent
results.description: Use reference images and Responses API conversation state to improve character, setting, and style consistency across an image series.

scores.rationale: 参考图和对话状态维持角色、场景与风格一致性，是可复用的图像生成模式。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Edit image details across turns》、《Chart analysis》，本资料的独立增量是：参考图和对话状态维持角色、场景与风格一致性，是可复用的图像生成模式。

results.title: API fundamentals
results.description: Cookbook recipes for the Model API building blocks — chat completions, streaming, tool calling, structured output, caching, reasoning, vision, and search grounding.

scores.rationale: API fundamentals 是 Cookbook 分类导航，知识由各专题指南承担。

results.title: Audit and resume agent sessions
results.description: Replay any Muse Code session exactly as it ran from an append-only event log, show who authorized each action, and resume a killed run with no duplicate side effects.

scores.rationale: 追加式事件日志、授权记录和无重复副作用恢复共同定义可审计代理会话。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Basic agent loop》、《Deterministic replay in CI》，本资料的独立增量是：追加式事件日志、授权记录和无重复副作用恢复共同定义可审计代理会话。

results.title: Basic agent loop
results.description: Wire up the core perceive-decide-act agent loop on Muse Spark.

scores.rationale: 感知—决策—行动循环是代理基础，但 Cookbook 实现由上位框架指南覆盖部分内容。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Audit and resume agent sessions》、《Deterministic replay in CI》，本资料的独立增量是：感知—决策—行动循环是代理基础，但 Cookbook 实现由上位框架指南覆盖部分内容。

results.title: Browser-verified web design
results.description: Build a website with OpenCode and Muse Spark using a Playwright browser MCP, so the agent opens the page it wrote, sees the rendered result, and fixes its own visual bugs.

scores.rationale: 让编码代理在真实浏览器中检查并修复视觉结果，是通用的闭环验证方法。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Multi-turn context management》、《Search-and-replace edits》，本资料的独立增量是：让编码代理在真实浏览器中检查并修复视觉结果，是通用的闭环验证方法。

results.title: Bundled skills
results.description: Drive the built-in /plan, /grilling, /grill-with-docs, and /taste skills end to end — plan a change, pressure-test it, record decisions, and build UI that doesn't look AI-made.

scores.rationale: 内置技能组合高度依赖 Muse Code，难以迁移为独立知识。

results.title: Building a computer-use agent with Muse Spark
results.description: Build a computer-use agent on Muse Spark that reads a screenshot, decides where to click and type, and drives a desktop environment until the task is done.

scores.rationale: 计算机使用示例补充了可运行循环，但核心机制已由主指南覆盖。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《GitHub agent》、《Interleaved reasoning and tool use》，本资料的独立增量是：计算机使用示例补充了可运行循环，但核心机制已由主指南覆盖。

results.title: Computer use on macOS with Muse Spark
results.description: Build a native macOS computer-use agent on Muse Spark that screenshots your Mac, decides where to click and type, and drives real apps through synthetic mouse and keyboard events.

scores.rationale: macOS 合成输入实现过于平台特定，跨平台适用范围不足。

results.title: Contained execution
results.description: Run every Muse Code command in an OS sandbox that refuses to proceed unless containment is proven live.

scores.rationale: 执行前证明沙箱已生效并在无法证明时拒绝运行，是关键的 fail-closed 安全模式。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Immutable guardrails》、《Sandboxed execution》，本资料的独立增量是：执行前证明沙箱已生效并在无法证明时拒绝运行，是关键的 fail-closed 安全模式。

results.title: Deterministic replay in CI
results.description: Turn recorded Muse Code events into a golden fixture and replay its model-context projection as a merge-blocking CI check.

scores.rationale: 把代理事件固定为黄金样本并在 CI 中确定性回放，可防止上下文投影和行为回归。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Audit and resume agent sessions》、《Basic agent loop》，本资料的独立增量是：把代理事件固定为黄金样本并在 CI 中确定性回放，可防止上下文投影和行为回归。

results.title: Error handling & retry patterns

scores.rationale: 退避、抖动和不可重试错误分类有实践价值，但与错误处理主指南明显重叠。

results.uniqueDelta: 本批同主题没有可直接替代资料；独立增量是：退避、抖动和不可重试错误分类有实践价值，但与错误处理主指南明显重叠。
